fact: The World Bank's project information document for the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project states that cross-border infrastructure between countries is missing in Zambia, hindering seamless digital trade; the document is dated 20 January 2025 and gives no earlier date.

fact: Zambia and Mozambique commissioned the Chanida-Cassacatiza cross-border fibre interconnector, linking Zambia's national backbone to Mozambique's submarine cable network, reported on 2026-02-23.
source_slug: 2026-02-23 Zambia and Mozambique launch fibre-optic interconnector at Chanida–Cassacatiza border
